prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: neck and back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully making a left turn when your insured failed to yield the right of way and struck the driver's side of our client's vehicle. The impact was significant enough to cause the airbags to deploy and to render the vehicle undrivable from the scene.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a cervical neck strain and a lumbar back strain. Following the accident, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has been undergoing a course of physical therapy, prescribed medication, and follow-up care. Our client continues to experience stiffness, persistent pain, and limitations in daily activities, including driving and lifting.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured admitted at the scene that he did not see our client's vehicle before proceeding through the intersection. Police documentation supports our client's account, and no comparative fault can reasonably be assigned to our client.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.
